subject: Balcony Seat Replacement Campaign
overview: The Commission reviewed ongoing theater maintenance and organ restoration progress while discussing funding strategies for a major project to replace balcony seating. Members also explored rideshare designations and gym facility repairs.

items.title: Theater Maintenance Updates
items.summary: Repaired the lobby elevator and issued a purchase order for roof leak repairs, while new banners were hung and bids for ceiling lights are expected soon.

items.title: Gym and Recreation Repairs
items.summary: Deferred a grant application for gym windows pending a repair assessment and requested a revised quote for basketball hoop repairs to fit available funding.

items.title: Rideshare and Wayfinding
items.summary: Discussed designating ride-share drop-off zones on Riverside Avenue and Salem Street as part of a forthcoming city-wide wayfinding study and consultant search.

items.title: Organ Restoration Status
items.summary: Announced that the organ restoration is two-thirds complete with a pending $45,000 contract to achieve 85% completion by spring 2025.

items.title: Balcony Seat Replacement Campaign
items.summary: Proposed a public 'sponsor a seat' campaign to supplement state earmarks and gaming commission grants for replacing wooden balcony seats with upholstered ones.

items.title: General Business and Next Meeting
items.summary: Announced the Friends of Chevalier annual meeting for October 24 and scheduled the next Commission meeting for September 11.
